full_judgment: 14. We have considered the impugned judgment and order and other papers on record. The high Court Division by a very cryptic and slipshod judgment disposed of the appeal and sent the suit on remand to the trial court for impleading the necessary parties although the trial Court on elaborate discussion of the evidence on record decreed the suit. The High Court Division came to a finding that necessary parties, that is, the Governing Body of the school and its members had not been impleaded in the suit. The High Court Division further held that according to the provision of Order 1 Rule 9 of the Code of Civil Procedure no suit would fail on the ground of non-joinder and mis-joinder of parties.
